skills.name: Dragon Flight
skills.description: Fly a long distance with your Dragon.

skills.name: Inherited Will
skills.description: You learned the dragon master's true power by receiving the will  of Afrien, the King of Onyx Dragon

skills.name: Rune Persistence
skills.description:
Increases the duration of Liberated Rune Power.

Level 3: Permanently increases Damage for Evan.

skills.name: Three Snails
skills.description:
[Master Level: 3]
Hurls snail shells to attack monsters from long distance.

skills.name: Recover
skills.description:
[Master Level: 3]
Allows you to steadily recover HP for 30 sec. 
Cooldown: 2 min

skills.name: Nimble Feet
skills.description:
[Master Level: 3]
Enables the character to move around quickly for a short amount of time. 
Cooldown: 1 min.

skills.name: Legendary Spirit
skills.description:
[Master Level: 1]
With the aid of a legendary spirit, you can now use scrolls on items that you can't equip.

skills.name: Back to Nature
skills.description: There's no place like... your farm.

skills.name: Magic Guard
skills.description:
A portion of the damage dealt to you affects your MP instead of your HP. Does not apply to attacks that inflict damage in proportion to your Max HP.
Activated automatically when you have at least 1 MP, and is ineffective when you have 0 MP.

skills.name: Dragon Soul
skills.description:
Your dragon contract increases your Defense, Speed, and Max Speed.
Chance to recover MP when attacking an enemy.

skills.name: Magic Link
skills.description: Shares Mir's magic, raising Evan's Magic ATT.

skills.name: Dragon Spark
skills.description: Whenever Evan makes a direct attack, Mir might attack too.

skills.name: Mana Burst I
skills.description: Two bursts of mana attack enemies in front. As you job advance, this skill improves, up to Mana Burst IV.

skills.name: Teleport
skills.description: Allows you to teleport a set distance to other locations on the same map using the arrow keys.

skills.name: Mana Burst II
skills.description: Three bursts of mana attack enemies in front. As you job advance, this skill improves, up to Mana Burst IV.

skills.name: Return Flash
skills.description:
[Fusion Skill] Mir immediately stops attacking and returns to Evan, cursing nearby enemies to take more damage.
This skill advances alongside Dragon Flash. 
\cActivates when Evan uses [Return] while Mir is using Dragon Flash, Wind Flash, or Thunder Flash.

skills.name: Wind Flash
skills.description:
[Fusion Skill] Sharp blades of wind blast enemies when Mir's Dragon Flash melds with Evan's magic. Wind Flash advances alongside Dragon Flash. You won't take damage when this skill targets enemies with attack reflection. 
\c Activates when Evan uses Wind Circle while Mir is using Dragon Flash.

skills.name: High Wisdom
skills.description: Your mental discipline permanently increase your INT.

skills.name: Partners
skills.description: Evan and Mir are partners on the battlefield, increasing their battle prowess.

skills.name: Spell Mastery
skills.description:
Increases Magic Mastery, Magic ATT, and Critical Rate.
Level 10 required to learn Magic Mastery.

skills.name: Wind Jump
skills.description: Create an air current to jump even higher. Press the jump button and the up direction key while jumping to reach greater heights. Can teleport once without a platform and the linked teleport allows you to go farther.

skills.name: Advanced Dragon Spark
skills.description: Whenever Evan makes a direct attack, Mir attacks, too.

skills.name: Dragon Flash
skills.description: [Mir Skill] Mir flashes between enemies, attacking all in his way. If this skill hits an enemy with attack reflection, you won't take damage.

skills.name: Agile Magic
skills.description: Increases Attack Speed and Intelligence.

skills.name: Wind Circle
skills.description: Launches a gust of wind to push enemies aside and deal damage. Can be resisted by some monsters.

skills.description:

skills.name: Return!
skills.description: Calls for Mir to immediately return to Evan's side. Various effects may activate based on the attack Mir was using when called.

skills.name: Mana Burst III
skills.description: Four bursts of mana attack enemies in front. As you job advance, this skill improves, up to Mana Burst IV.

skills.name: Return Dive
skills.description:
[Fusion Skill] Mir immediately stops attacking and returns to Evan, buffing you and all party members' Attack Speed by 1. 
This skill advances alongside Dragon Dive. 
\cActivates when Evan uses [Return] while Mir is using Dragon Dive, Thunder Dive, and Earth Dive.

skills.name: Thunder Flash
skills.description:
[Fusion Skill] Five pentacles of thunder appear and crash into enemies when Mir's Dragon Flash melds with Evan's magic. Thunder Flash advances alongside Dragon Flash. You won't take damage when this skill targets enemies with attack reflection. 
Activates when Evan uses Thunder Circle while Mir is using Dragon Flash.

skills.name: Thunder Dive
skills.description:
[Fusion Skill] Generates powerful orbs of electricity when Mir's Dragon Dive melds with Evan's magic. Thunder Dive advances alongside Dragon Dive. You won't take damage when this skill targets enemies with attack reflection. 
Activates when Evan uses Thunder Circle while Mir is using Dragon Dive.

skills.name: Critical Magic
skills.description: Increases Critical Rate and Critical Damage.

skills.name: Magic Resistance
skills.description: Increases your Abnormal Status Resistance and Elemental Resistance.

skills.name: Magic Amplification
skills.description: Increases the MP cost and the Magic Attack of your magic skills.

skills.name: Dragon Potential
skills.description: Draws out Mir's potential and reveals his hidden abilities.

skills.name: Dragon Dive
skills.description: [Mir Skill] Mir dives in front of Evan, creating shockwaves with the beating of his wings. You won't take damage when this skill targets enemies with attack reflection.

skills.name: Elemental Decrease
skills.description: Temporarily decreases Elemental Resistance to all of your attacks. Also permanently increases final damage.

skills.name: Magic Debris
skills.description:
Magic debris forms around enemies hit by fusion skills. Activate the debris to damage enemies around Evan. The damage is proportional to the amount of debris activated at once.
In Auto Mode, it is automatically activated whenever a certain number of Magic Debris are created.
Auto Mode On/Off: Right-click

skills.name: Mana Burst IV
skills.description: Four bursts of highly condensed mana attack enemies in front, twice in a row. This is the final version of Mana Burst.

skills.name: Return Flame
skills.description: [Fusion Skill] Mir immediately stops attacking and returns to Evan, scorching enemies with a curtain of flame. This skill advances alongside Dragon Breath. Activates when Evan uses [Return] while Mir is using Dragon Breath, Wind Breath, or Earth Breath.

skills.name: Earth Breath
skills.description: [Fusion Skill] Mir breathes out flames that homes in on enemies when his Dragon Breath melds with Evan's magic. Earth Breath advances alongside Dragon Breath. You won't take damage when this skill targets enemies with attack reflection. Activates when Evan uses Earth Circle while Mir is using Dragon Breath.

skills.name: Wind Breath
skills.description:
[Fusion Skill] Mir breathes out a storm of flames that deal a tremendous amount of damage when his Dragon Breath melds with Evan's magic. Wind Breath advances alongside Dragon Breath. You won't take damage when this skill targets enemies with attack reflection. 
Activates when Evan uses Wind Circle while Mir is using Dragon Breath.

skills.name: Earth Dive
skills.description: [Fusion Skill] Smashes a boulder into enemies in front when Mir's Dragon Dive melds with Evan's magic. Earth Dive advances alongside Dragon Dive. You won't take damage when this skill targets enemies with attack reflection. Activates when Evan uses Earth Circle while Mir is using Dragon Dive.

skills.name: Enhanced Magic Debris
skills.description: Forms enhanced magic debris around enemies struck by fusion skills. Activate the debris to damage enemies around Evan. The damage is proportional to the amount of debris activated at once.
skills.note: Effect frames are stored nested in the WZ (effect/0/0-5, duplicated identically in effect/1); flattened in source order — the 6 debris sprites are distinct images, each with its own delay/origin.

skills.name: Magic Mastery
skills.description: Enhances Magic Mastery, Magic ATT, and Critical Damage.

skills.name: Onyx Will
skills.description: Grows your camaraderie and your physical capabilities. Reduces damage taken and permanently increases Knockback Resistance.

skills.name: Dragon Fury
skills.description: The focus of the Dragon strengthens and your Magic Attack increases.

skills.name: High Dragon Potential
skills.description: Fully draws out Mir's potential and reveals his hidden abilities.

skills.name: Speedy Dragon Flash
skills.description: Reduces the cooldown of Dragon Flash.

skills.name: Howling Wind
skills.description: Increases the number of Wind Flash's wind blades.

skills.name: Rolling Thunder
skills.description: Increases the number of attacks per Thunder Flash's crashes.

skills.name: Speedy Dragon Dive
skills.description: Reduces Dragon Dive's cooldown.

skills.name: Thunder Overload
skills.description: Increase the number of orbs created by Thunder Dive.

skills.name: Earth-Shattering Dive
skills.description: Increases Earth Dive's damage.

skills.name: Speedy Dragon Breath
skills.description: Reduces Dragon Breath's cooldown.

skills.name: Lungs of Stone
skills.description: Increases Earth Breath's number of breaths.

skills.name: Cyclone Breath
skills.description: Increases Wind Breath's special effect HP requirement and damage.

skills.name: Earth Circle
skills.description: Forms an irregular pentacle that raises the ground and damages enemies.

skills.name: Dragon Breath
skills.description:
[Mir Skill] Releases a fiery breath that scorches enemies in front. Not affected by attack reflection.
Skill damage increases from the Dragon Breath passive trump the damage increases of Dragon Dive.
Mir's skills and fusion skills aren't affected by Attack Speed increases.

skills.name: Maple Warrior
skills.description: The Goddess of Maple World's grace increases your stats. Using the skill briefly makes the Goddess of Maple World appear.

skills.name: Hero's Will
skills.description:
Hones your resolve to ignore certain abnormal status effects. Immune to most abnormal status effects for 3 sec. after use. Certain abnormal status effects will still get through. Does not apply Combat Orders.
Can be used while using other skills.

skills.name: Blessing of the Onyx
skills.description: Increases Defense and Magic Attack. Does not stack with Photic Meditation.

skills.name: Dragon Master
skills.description: Hop on Mir's back and fly freely through the air, breathing fire. While mounted, press the Dragon Master skill key to attack. Dismounts immediately when you release the skill key.

skills.name: Summon Onyx Dragon
skills.description: Summons the ancient Onyx Dragon to aid you in battle. The Onyx Dragon's attacks will not be affected by enemies with attack reflection.

skills.name: Heroic Memories
skills.description: Recalls the oath of the Maple Heroes to increase damage.

skills.name: Dark Fog
skills.description: A dark, cold fog descends, attacking multiple enemies at once. Applies additional Critical Rate and Magic Debris's damage increases.

skills.name: Wyrmking's Breath
skills.description:
[Fusion Skill] Evan infuses Mir with his magic during Dragon Slam, causing Mir to briefly grow and release a blast of elemental energy. This skill advances alongside Dragon Slam. Unaffected by attack reflection.
\c Activates when Evan uses Elemental Barrage while Mir is using Dragon Slam.

skills.name: Ludicrous Speed
skills.description:
[Fusion Skill] Mir immediately stops attacking and teleports to Evan, creating a vortex that deals damage to nearby enemies.
This skill advances alongside Dragon Slam.
\c Activates when Evan uses [Return] while Mir is using Dragon Slam or Wyrmking's Breath.

skills.name: Mana Overload
skills.description:
Increases your attack skills by overloading the mana flowing through you.
Right-click to lock activation effect.

skills.name: Dragon Slam
skills.description:
[Mir Skill] Mir slams down and savagely attacks the enemy. Unaffected by attack reflection.
Mir's skills and fusion skills are not affected by effects that increase attack speed.

skills.name: Ethereal Form
skills.description: Move to a different dimension to become invincible. Use the skill again to return.

skills.name: Elemental Radiance
skills.description: Cast a magical circle to channel the power of the constellations. Magic ATT starts to charge the magic circle when Evan's magic (excluding Spiral of Mana) hits a target, culminating when Magic ATT is full. Unaffected by attack reflection. Only the first attack of Elemental Barrage will have the element applied.

skills.name: Spiral of Mana
skills.description:
Utilize the Mana Burst's pentacle to allow clusters of mana to swirl with the speed of a tornado on their own. 
There can be only 1 Spiral of Mana. Unaffected by attack reflection.
With Action Customization enabled, you can use Mana Burst again with the down arrow key.
Right-click to toggle Action Customization ON/OFF

skills.name: Surging Essence
skills.description: Fill the earth's flowing essence with magic and make it bloom, causing a mountain land spirit to surge forth. Unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Zodiac Burst
skills.description:
Evan and Mir harness the resonance of the stars to create a giant constellation. When this attack skill hits, the power of the stars resonates with the magic to create a meteor shower. The meteor shower erupts on the boss with the highest Max HP first, and is unaffected by attack reflection.

Lv. 10 - Ignore Defense: +20%
Lv. 20 - Boss Damage: +20%
Lv. 30 - Ignore Defense: +30%, Boss Damage: +30%
